title.zh: 时隔16个月，百度再次亮出大模型家底：2800亿参数文心5.5 Flash开源
title.en: 时隔16个月，百度再次亮出大模型家底：2800亿参数文心5.5 Flash开源

current_state.zh: Baidu open-sourced ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, a 280B-parameter (14B active) MoE model pretrained on 33.5T tokens with up to 1M-token context, claiming first place on 24 of 30 benchmarks versus DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base and other Chinese peers, under a custom license barring use in the EU, UK and South Korea and requiring written approval for large commercial users.
